intro: Lesson 30 homework. Mark it yourself with the mark scheme.

questions.q: What is stored in the memory address register (MAR)?
questions.a: The address of the memory location to be read from or written to

questions.q: What does the control unit do?
questions.a: Decodes instructions and sends control signals to the other parts of the computer

questions.q: State what is meant by the 'stored program' idea in the von Neumann architecture.
questions.a: Instructions and data are stored together in the same memory

questions.q: Explain how cache memory improves performance.
questions.a: It is small, very fast memory in or near the CPU that holds frequently used data and instructions, so the CPU waits less for slower RAM

questions.q: Why does a computer need secondary storage?
questions.a: It is non-volatile, so it keeps programs and files when the power is off, and holds far more than RAM

questions.q: Give one example of optical storage and one suitable use.
questions.a: A DVD (or Blu-ray) to distribute films or software

questions.q: A school backs up 2 TB of files every night. Suggest a suitable type of storage and give a reason.
questions.a: Magnetic (hard disk or tape): very large capacity at a low cost per gigabyte

questions.q: What is virtual memory, and why does it slow a computer down?
questions.a: Part of secondary storage used as extra RAM when RAM is full; secondary storage is much slower to read and write
